app.title: SAM 3D Body → Unity FBX
app.heading: 🧍‍♂️ SAM 3D Body → Unity Humanoid FBX
features: Generate Unity Humanoid-compatible FBX files from a single image
Generate multi-frame animations from MP4 videos
usage: Use the Pose Estimation tab to upload an image or MP4 video
After pose estimation completes, switch to the Generate FBX tab
(Optional) Download the generated JSON for future use, tuning refinement, etc.
Download the generated FBX → Import to Unity
Upload your own bboxes and camera intrinsics file from gta-link, boxmot, colmap
For video, you may or may not want root motion for your armature - check the box if you do
Apply standard mocap-style smoothing to the animation via Refinement. Enabled by default with some customizable settings.

ui.missing_bbox_behavior_info: What to do when bbox data is missing for a frame: Run Detection (use num_people to detect) or Skip Frame (skip pose estimation for that frame)

tracking.mode_info: Choose how people are tracked during pose estimation
tracking.enabled_info: Turn inference tracking on/off (only applies in Inference Tracking mode)
tracking.max_gap_frames_info: Max frame gap before a tracklet is closed
tracking.merge_max_gap_frames_info: Max gap allowed when merging tracklets
tracking.min_tracklet_length_info: Minimum detections required to keep a tracklet
tracking.min_similarity_info: Minimum similarity score to link detections
tracking.min_cam_similarity_info: Reject matches when cam similarity is below this (e.g. 0.01 rejects cam=0 teleports). Only when Use pred_cam_t is on.
tracking.min_pose_similarity_info: Reject matches when pose similarity is below this (e.g. 0.3 rejects ~30% pose agreement). Only when Use Pose Aux is on. 0 = no gate.
tracking.shape_maturity_frames_info: Trust shape only after this many detections in the tracklet. Below this, match on pose and cam only (age-aware re-ID).
tracking.high_shape_override_cam_info: When tracklet is mature and shape similarity is very high, allow match even if cam is low (same person re-emerged elsewhere).
tracking.high_shape_threshold_info: Shape similarity threshold for the override above (e.g. 0.95).
tracking.pose_distance_threshold_info: Distance threshold for pose auxiliary similarity
tracking.iou_distance_threshold_info: Distance threshold for bbox IoU (requires bbox_xywh)

ui.fov_method_info: Default: Built-in, runs every frame | File: Load from cameras.txt | Sample: Average from images
ui.fov_file: 📁 Camera Intrinsics File (COLMAP cameras.txt or MoGe format)
ui.sample_number_info: Number of images to sample and average for FOV estimation
ui.precision_info: FP32 for best quality, BF16/FP16 for faster inference
ui.frame_batch_size_info: Run pose model once per N frames (1 = per-frame). 4 or 8 can speed up video. Higher = more GPU memory.
ui.detection_batch_size_info: When no BBOX file: number of images per detector batch (1 = per-frame). Higher can speed up detection.
ui.auto_floor_info: Offset the average pred_cam_t height to 0 so subjects stand above the floor
ui.use_personalized_body_info: Generate a personalized body mesh from estimation data. If unchecked, uses default LOD body.
ui.outlier_removal_percent_info: Percentage of outliers to remove from each tail (0-50)
ui.extrinsics_invert_quaternion_info: Treat qvec as camera→world instead of world→camera
ui.extrinsics_invert_translation_info: Treat tvec as camera→world instead of world→camera
ui.pose_json_file_info: Upload a pose estimation JSON file, or it will be auto-populated after estimation

pose_dev.run_bbox_detection_now_info: Run detection on the current input (video or image) and save an MOT file. Use with **BBOX File** to skip re-detection when estimating.
pose_dev.debug_start_frame_info: Frame index where step-through and per-frame debug begin (0 = from first frame). Use to jump near a problem frame.

ui.cancel_current_jobs_info: Stop any running Estimate Pose or Generate FBX job (requires queue).
ui.pose_cli_generator_info: Create a command template for pose estimation. Replace <INPUT_FILE> and other placeholders before running.
ui.pose_cli_command_info: Template command for pose estimation runs
ui.fbx_cli_generator_info: Create a command template for FBX generation. Replace <INPUT_FILE> and other placeholders before running.
ui.fbx_cli_command_info: Template command for FBX generation runs

refinement.title: Refinement
refinement.max_pos_speed_info: Maximum positional speed (units/sec) for spike detection
refinement.max_pos_accel_info: Maximum positional acceleration (units/sec²) for spike detection
refinement.max_ang_speed_deg_info: Maximum angular speed (deg/sec) for spike detection
refinement.max_ang_accel_deg_info: Maximum angular acceleration (deg/sec²) for spike detection
refinement.one_euro_min_cutoff_info: Minimum cutoff frequency for One Euro filter
refinement.one_euro_beta_info: Speed coefficient for One Euro filter
refinement.one_euro_d_cutoff_info: Derivative cutoff frequency for One Euro filter
refinement.root_cutoff_xy_hz_info: Cutoff frequency for horizontal (XY) root motion
refinement.root_cutoff_z_hz_info: Cutoff frequency for vertical (Z) root motion
refinement.interpolate_missing_keyframes_info: When enabled, missing frames (where no people were detected) will be interpolated using slerp for rotations and linear interpolation for vectors. When disabled, missing frames are skipped during refinement.
refinement.use_foot_planting_info: Enable foot planting to adjust root motion based on foot contact, reducing jitter and creating more natural walking/running motion

foot_planting.title: Foot Planting
foot_planting.foot_contact_velocity_threshold_info: Foot is considered 'planted' if its velocity is below this threshold
foot_planting.foot_contact_min_height_info: Foot must be below this height (Y coordinate) to be considered in contact
foot_planting.contact_smoothing_window_info: Number of frames to use for smoothing contact detection (reduces flickering)
foot_planting.blend_factor_info: How much to blend foot-based root adjustment with original root motion (0-1, higher = more adjustment)
foot_planting.root_smoothing_window_info: Number of frames to use for smoothing the adjusted root motion
foot_planting.use_mid_foot_info: Use mid_foot (average of heel/toes) instead of ankle for foot position

errors.bbox_file_required: BBOX file must be provided when 'use bbox' is enabled
errors.num_people_required: Number of people must be greater than 0
errors.camera_intrinsics_required: Camera intrinsics file must be provided when FOV method is 'File'
errors.fov_estimator_required: FOV estimator must be loaded to use 'Sample' method. Please ensure FOV estimator is initialized.
errors.pose_json_file_required: Please provide a pose estimation JSON file
